subject: Pilot billing cadence & conditional credit cap — Aurelia Therapeutics
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tellis@aurelia-thera.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot billing cadence / credit request

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. The pilot is live on our side and usage is starting to show up in our staging account. We need to align on payment cadence for the next 90 days while procurement wraps up our PO process.

Ask: Would Redwood consider Net45 for the pilot invoices, with a conditional temporary credit cap of USD 250,000 while we complete vendor onboarding?

Operational notes:
- We can do ACH once Redwood confirms bank details.
- VAT: Aurelia is VAT-exempt for clinical research — we can provide certificate if needed.
- We will need an invoice schedule tied to milestones: initial consumption invoice (30%) after go-live, mid-pilot review invoice (40%), final reconciliation (30%).

Attaching a short payment request doc and our bank stub for routing.

Tom Ellis
Head of Finance
Aurelia Therapeutics
attachments: Aurelia_Payment_Request_May2026.pdf, Vendor_Bank_Stub_Aurelia.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tellis@aurelia-thera.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence / credit request

Tom — thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. Appreciate the milestone breakdown, that helps.

Quick proposal from our side (option framing so procurement has something to react to):
1) Preferred: Net45 on pilot invoices, conditional credit cap of USD 200,000 for 60 days while onboarding completes. Rolling review at day 45 to either lift or reduce the cap.
2) Alternate: Net30 with 15% prepay applied to first invoice, credit cap USD 250,000 for 60 days.

Naomi — can you confirm whether Finance is comfortable with a 200k conditional cap + a 45-day rolling review? Marissa — flagging for contract and can you prepare a one-page amendment (payment ladder) and a short DocuSign envelope if they accept.

If Aurelia can provide VAT evidence and the vendor bank stub (received), we can fast-track routing. I attached a draft payment schedule to illustrate the 30/40/30 split with invoice dates aligned to go-live and 30-day review.

Next step: Tom, if option 1 looks OK we will issue an amendment and a DocuSign link; if not, choose option 2 and we'll send the prepay invoice.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Director, Redwood Inference
attachments: Draft_Payment_Schedule_Redwood_v1.xlsx

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence / credit request

Looping in here with a quick Finance position.

- We are comfortable with a temporary credit cap for new pilots, but recommend USD 200,000 rather than 250k to keep exposure aligned with expected pilot consumption.
- We want the cap to be time-boxed to 60 days and include a hard review at day 45 with usage and payment performance as triggers to keep/raise/reduce the cap.
- VAT evidence: please provide the VAT exemption certificate and a remit name that matches the bank stub.
- Banking: we will share ACH details for Redwood's AR once the amendment is countersigned.

Marissa, please draft a one-page amendment that: 1) sets Net45 during the pilot, 2) documents the USD200k cap and 60-day window, and 3) includes the 30/40/30 invoice ladder. Include spaces for VAT/Tax evidentiary attachments.

Naomi Feldman
Finance Ops Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Ellis <tellis@aurelia-thera.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurelia Therapeutics - AP <accounts@aurelia-thera.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence / credit request

Hi Logan / Naomi / Marissa — thanks for the quick turn.

Aurelia can accept the conditional approach. We agree to: Net45, USD200,000 temporary cap for 60 days, and the 30/40/30 invoice ladder tied to the milestones you outlined. We will provide:
- VAT exemption certificate (PDF)
- Bank remit confirmation (we attached Vendor_Bank_Stub_Aurelia.pdf earlier — happy to re-send with the AP contact).

Please send the one-page amendment and DocuSign link and we will get countersigned on our side within 48 hours. ACH routing is fine.

Tom Ellis
Head of Finance
Aurelia Therapeutics
attachments: Vendor_Bank_Stub_Aurelia.pdf
